role.author: Author
roleDescription.owner: Everything, including other owners and admins
roleDescription.admin: Course, policy, providers and non-privileged people
roleDescription.author: Edits course drafts; no learner records
roleDescription.instructor: Assigned learners' permitted evidence and extensions
roleDescription.reviewer: Approves releases, content and evidence reviews
roleDescription.support_observer: Read-only support: course, enrollment and policy state and the audit log; nothing learner-private
roleDescription.service: Integration account: read-only course and enrollment state (owners assign it)
roleDescription.course_scoped: No workspace-wide access; only the courses granted below, until each grant expires
error.FORBIDDEN: Only workspace owners and admins manage people.
error.ROLE_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: Your role cannot make this change. Only owners manage owners and admins.
error.SELF_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN: You cannot change or remove your own membership. Ask another owner.
error.STALE_ROLE: This person's role changed since you loaded the list. Refresh and try again.
error.SIGN_IN_NOT_ISSUABLE: A sign-in code can only be issued for people invited into this workspace who have no other workspace access.
error.PASSWORD_NOT_SETTABLE: A temporary password can only be set for people invited into this workspace who have no other workspace access.
error.LOGIN_NAME_REQUIRED: Choose a username for this person.
error.LOGIN_NAME_TAKEN: That username belongs to someone else. Choose another.
error.LOGIN_CODES_DISABLED: One-time sign-in codes are turned off on this server.
error.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This person is no longer a member. Refresh the list.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: A previous request with this retry key had different content. Refresh and try again.
error.COURSE_SCOPED_MEMBER_REQUIRED: Course access is only for people whose workspace role is course_scoped. Change their role first.
error.COURSE_GRANT_EXISTS: This person already has access to this course. Revoke it before granting a different role.
error.COURSE_GRANT_REVOKED: That access was already revoked. Refresh the list.
error.GRANT_EXPIRY_INVALID: Choose an expiry between now and one year ahead.
error.INVALID_INPUT: Check the name, username, role and reason, then try again. Usernames use 3–128 letters, digits and {symbols}
error.unavailable: The people service is unavailable. No membership was changed.
